name: Carrot cake

For 1L small mold: Little amount of oil or butter

instructions: - Preheat oven to 176ºC, toast the walnuts 7 minutes.
- Mix everything else, starting with eggs, sugar and slowly the oil, then the rest, with the flour last.

- Before it finishes, make the glaze by mixing everything. If the sugar is powdered, you can mix them cold. If it's granulated, try warming up the cream to dissolve the sugar crystals better, then refrigerate.
- Take cake out, glaze. I recommend on top and in the middle for extra moisture.

culinary: Do not attempt to take it out of the mold before it's cold since it may crumble easily.
